items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover, arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe released isolated patch files for these issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary code execution via webhooks
items.summary: This vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, has a CVSS score of 10.0 and allows an unauthenticated attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution through the webhooks component without user interaction. Adobe reported no known exploitation in the wild at the time of the patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 13 vulnerabilities, with eight rated as critical, including CVE-2026-48358, which can lead to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Successful exploitation could also result in privilege escalation and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) in Amasty Order Attributes allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload executable files to a Magento store, leading to remote code execution. Amasty released a fix in version 4.0.0, and Sansec observed active exploitation attempts shortly after the patch.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: This critical flaw (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows unauthenticated remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie due to PHP object injection. CISA added this vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation.
